[EN] {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest} still isn't safe for our researchers. I'd appreciate it if you'd go after those {@LinkCreature:47#1001#Tirkai grizzlies}. Thin out the {@LinkCreature:47#4001#argonomorph Dagonite crusaders}, and {@LinkCreature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps} while you're at it.

{@Creature:247#1002$$Salaine} at {@Rgn:47006$$Field Base Lunacy} will take care of your reward.
[ES] {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest} todavía no es seguro para nuestros investigadores. Te agradecería que fueras tras esos {@LinkCreature:47#1001#Tirkai grizzlies}. Diezma a los {@LinkCreature:47#4001#argonomorph Dagonite crusaders} y a los {@LinkCreature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps} mientras estás en ello.

{@Creature:247#1002$$Salaine} en {@Rgn:47006$$Field Base Lunacy} se encargará de tu recompensa.

[EN] Thank you.

You've helped make us all a little safer.
[ES] Gracias.

Has ayudado a hacernos a todos un poco más seguros.

[EN] When you've thinned out the {@LinkCreature:47#1001#Tirkai grizzlies}, {@LinkCreature:47#4001#argonomorph Dagonite crusaders}, and {@LinkCreature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps} in {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest}, come on back.
[ES] Cuando hayas diezmado a los {@LinkCreature:47#1001#Tirkai grizzlies}, {@LinkCreature:47#4001#argonomorph Dagonite crusaders} y {@LinkCreature:47#2001#argonomorph caprin imps} en {@Rgn:47002$$Whitefrost Forest}, regresa.
